subject: The delimitation bill: seats, MPs, and in the end the scams
alt: Subhani’s cartoon: at the upper left a hand-lettered caption reads: DELIMITATION BILL... Below stands a long queue of politicians; each holds a paper, all look upward and their mouths are open. From the left: a man in a green cap, a woman in a red sari, a man with a thick moustache, a woman in a green dupatta, and a man in glasses; then an old man with a white beard scratching his head, a man in a pale blue kurta and a white stole holding a paper, and three more men on the right. There are three speech bubbles. The first: ...MORE SEATS, MORE MPs... The second: ...MORE EXPENDITURE... The third: ...MORE CORRUPTION AND MORE SCAMS. Subhani’s signature is at the lower right.
chutki: At the announcement of the delimitation bill a queue of politicians has formed; every hand holds a paper, and all three bubbles are doing the same arithmetic - seats, MPs, expenditure, and finally the scams.

The needle is in the counting. Not one face in the queue asks whose representation will grow in the larger House; each is weighing his own share. And the bubbles say what else grows on the same excuse: the spending, and the scams.
